description: Declared pilot cost assumptions. Model prices and labor rates are stated inputs, not measurements; replace them with the provider contract and the operator's labor rate before trusting projected totals. Token counts for arm A come from pilot/meter-session.mjs (provider-reported usage), wall-clock from the same durable session log.

A.notes: Prompt/harness construction is a one-time setup; every automatic answer needs a per-request human review (0.5 min) because a fresh agent has no pre-verified routine.

B.notes: Hand-written guard/binding/conversion from the contract; deterministic, so no per-request review.

C.notes: Routine hooks, dev/audit/challenge fixtures, independent reference check, gate review and routing integration.
